description: Working Profile dialog (employee-master details for the logged-in user + change password) and per-user favourite menus pinned at the top of the sidebar.
api_endpoints: GET /auth/profile (employee master fields for the current user)
schema_changes: sysm_user_favourite_menu_dtl — per-user pinned menu codes with sort order (FK to sysm_userlogin_mst, unique on user+menu)
notes: Profile is view-only from employee master (HR edits stay on Employee Master). Favourites are capped at 12, filtered to menus the user can view, and appear in a Favourites section at the top of the sidebar; manage via avatar menu or the sidebar Edit link.
